svg.text: Today's layout kept (gate, Mall path, cross walk, the Round, castle, towers, brook, the big lake's quarter, skate extension). Now crammed with our trees (real size, climbable): the big elms set well back, smaller trees nearer, no crown over any path. A low iron fence edges every path, benches every 4 m, Polyfork structures.
